items.question: What is to be given at the end in the outer part?
premises: bahirbhāge means in the outer part
items.inference: The verse prescribes something to be given at the end in the outer part, yellow and combined with orpiment and similar substances.
uncertainties: The exact object of dātavyā is not specified in this verse
The precise ritual context of the outer part remains unclear
items.plain_english: At the end, in the outer part, (something) to be given, yellow, combined with orpiment and the like.
